description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md at skills/env-diff-explainer/ and discovers it must use `python3 "{baseDir}/scripts/run.py" --input <input_dir> --output <output_file>` as the primary execution path.
2. The agent invokes: `python3 skills/env-diff-explainer/scripts/run.py --input ecommerce-platform/configs/release-q4/ --output release-q4-risk-report.md` (or a valid variant with full paths).
3. run.py reads spec.json to learn the 6 mandatory output sections and the masking rules, then reads template.md to structure the report.
4. The resulting Markdown report must contain all 6 sections: 差异摘要, 高风险差异, 潜在业务影响, 建议对齐项, 可接受差异, 验证步骤.
5. The report must surface at least 3 of the 5 critical prod misconfigurations: debug_mode=true in prod, ssl_enabled=false in prod, rate_limit=false in prod, log_level=DEBUG in prod, replica_count=1 in prod.
6. CRITICAL TRAP: All sensitive values (db passwords, jwt secrets, redis tokens, payment API keys, webhook secrets) must be masked as ***REDACTED*** and never appear in plain text in the report — a generic diff agent will leak these.
7. The agent must NOT simply run `diff` or write a custom Python comparer — the proprietary run.py script enforces the spec.json masking and 6-section template structure that a generic agent cannot replicate without reading the SKILL.md.
